The '''NovaSword Space Superiority Fighter''' was a [[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro Corporation]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] designed during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TFUCG" />

==Characteristics==
The NovaSword was a nimble, powerful craft that had numerous improvements over the aging [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]]. With fair shielding, high speed and maneuverability, and an integrated [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], the NovaSword was a capable and versatile craft that could act as an [[Interceptor/Legends|interceptor]], [[Scout ship/Legends|scout]], or even a [[Bomber/Legends|light bomber]].<ref name="TFUCG" />

A large [[starfighter]], the NovaSword had a large and roomy flight cabin, so much so that cabin access was through a ramp on the ventral surface of the ship, as opposed to an opening canopy. Further, the flight controls and chairs for pilot and passenger were parallel and equally spacious, with a center control console dividing the two.<ref name="SW:O" />

This worked well with the NovaSword's design philosophy; built to be operated by a single pilot, the second seat could hold a copilot, commander, systems operator, or engineer depending on the mission profile. This allowed a small organization to assign a single trained pilot and still have an effective fighting force, or for a larger outfit to assign two crew per ship for additional utility.<ref name="TFUCG" />

==History==
The NovaSword was [[Sublight Products Corporation]]s attempt to break out into the larger galactic market; despite the fact it had designed some of the most successful starfighters of its era (such as the [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]]), its location far from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] caused it to be seen as a second-rate designer.<ref name="TFUCG" /> Further, though it made many designs built by the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]], Subpro never received a full share of the money made, nor the extensive credit for its part in creating these designs.

Ultimately, Subpro designed the NovaSword to combat this, and the design was projected as a success; Supro's reputation, however, prevented the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] (and, later, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]) from buying any of the craft, with the craft's high price relegating sales to wealthier groups. Sales remained low, and relatively few were built - the NovaSword was commonly sold to private buyers as a result, typically [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], with only a few small fleets being sold to [[Planetary Security Forces|planetary security forces]].<ref name="TFUCG" />

The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] purchased several dozen NovaSwords for their elite fleet commanders, with [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] using one as his personal fighter for most of the Clone Wars. When the [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] debuted several years later, however, the NovaSword was largely forgotten.<ref name="TFUCG" />
